notes:
Refers to the true state of affairs within an organization, household, or situation that is not publicly known. Composed of ⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (inside) and ⟦{情|じょう}→情：03343_jou⟧ (circumstances). Often carries a nuance of hidden or behind-the-scenes reality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内情|ないじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧: know the inside story
- {内情|ないじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暴露|ばくろ}する→暴露する：18209_bakurosuru⟧: expose internal affairs
- {内情|ないじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧: be well-informed about internal matters
- {内情|ないじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さぐ}る→探る：03923_saguru⟧: probe the true circumstances

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧: circumstances — more neutral, not necessarily hidden
- ⟦{内幕|うちまく}→内幕：21968_uchimaku⟧: the inside story — emphasizes what goes on behind the scenes
- ⟦{実情|じつじょう}→実情：17770_jitsujou⟧: actual conditions — focuses on the real situation vs. appearances
